nodes.name: python-sdk
nodes.summary: Python implementation of the Model Context Protocol (MCP): build servers that expose tools, resources and prompts to LLM applications, and clients that connect to them, over stdio, Streamable HTTP and SSE.

nodes.name: Client
nodes.summary: MCP client: open a session to a server over stdio, Streamable HTTP or SSE, then list and call its tools, resources and prompts.

nodes.name: Server core
nodes.summary: Low-level MCP server: the protocol session, request/notification dispatch and the three server transports underneath the high-level API.

nodes.name: MCPServer (FastMCP)
nodes.summary: The decorator API that turns type-hinted Python functions into tools, resources and prompts with JSON schemas derived automatically.

nodes.name: OAuth 2.0 auth
nodes.summary: OAuth 2.0 for both sides: the client's authorization-code and token flow, and the server's bearer-token verification, client registration and metadata endpoints.

nodes.name: Shared runtime
nodes.summary: Runtime shared by client and server: the JSON-RPC dispatcher, the session/peer base, message framing, the in-memory transport and cross-cutting utilities.

nodes.name: Protocol types
nodes.summary: The MCP wire protocol as Pydantic models: request, result and notification types, versioned per spec revision (the mcp-types package).

nodes.name: CLI
nodes.summary: The `mcp` command-line tool: dev, run and install for running a server and registering it with Claude Desktop.

nodes.name: Outside services and people
nodes.summary: The libraries, runtime, protocol and peers the SDK depends on.

nodes.name: Libraries & runtime
nodes.summary: Third-party packages the SDK builds on and the protocol it implements.

nodes.name: Peers & hosts
nodes.summary: The processes and people at the other end of an MCP connection.

nodes.name: anyio
nodes.summary: Async runtime providing structured concurrency, task groups and memory object streams used throughout the SDK.

nodes.name: httpx
nodes.summary: HTTP client (httpx2) used for outbound Streamable HTTP/SSE connections and OAuth token requests.

nodes.name: Starlette
nodes.summary: ASGI framework the HTTP transports and OAuth routes mount into.

nodes.name: uvicorn
nodes.summary: ASGI server that runs a Streamable HTTP or SSE MCP server.

nodes.name: Pydantic
nodes.summary: Validation library (Pydantic v2) behind every wire type and the tool and argument schemas.

nodes.name: jsonschema
nodes.summary: JSON Schema validator used to check tool input and output against declared schemas.

nodes.name: sse-starlette
nodes.summary: Server-Sent Events responses used by the SSE transport.

nodes.name: MCP specification
nodes.summary: The Model Context Protocol specification whose revisions the wire types implement.

nodes.name: MCP host / LLM app
nodes.summary: The LLM application or host that embeds an MCP client, such as an IDE, chat app or agent.

nodes.name: Remote MCP server
nodes.summary: A server at the other end of a client connection, exposing tools, resources and prompts.

nodes.name: OAuth authorization server
nodes.summary: External OAuth 2.0 authorization server that issues and validates access tokens.

nodes.name: Claude Desktop
nodes.summary: Desktop host; `mcp install` registers a server into its configuration file.
